text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - A report by the People's Bank, the central bank, says China's financial status was good in January and February with inflation falling to about three percent and money supply declining.
- A poll shows that 38.3 percent of Chinese investors see state debt as their first choice in securities investment.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Expert says the property market should not be treated as a new pillar industry in China.
- An estimated 130 billion yuan worth of short-term funds are now invested on China's stock primary market with an increasing number of new domestic A shares being issued.
